% !BIB program = bibtex
%
% ============================================================================
%  ResearchLens AI — IEEE Conference Paper Template
% ============================================================================
%  Ready-to-use IEEE conference paper layout based on the official IEEEtran
%  LaTeX class documentation:
%
%    "How to Use the IEEEtran LATEX Templates", IEEE Publication Technology,
%    IEEE Journal of LaTeX Class Files, Vol. 18, No. 9, September 2020.
%
%  Document class for a conference paper:
%      \documentclass[conference]{IEEEtran}
%  Computer Society conference paper:
%      \documentclass[conference,compsoc]{IEEEtran}
%  Communications Society journal/conference:
%      \documentclass[journal,comsoc]{IEEEtran}
%  Technical note / correspondence:
%      \documentclass[9pt,technote]{IEEEtran}
%
%  IEEE template selector (conference-specific variants + MS Word):
%      https://template-selector.ieee.org/
% ============================================================================

\documentclass[conference]{IEEEtran}

% ----- Packages used by the IEEEtran conference format -----
\usepackage{cite}                          % numeric citations: \cite{x} -> [x]
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsfonts}     % mathematics
\usepackage{amsthm}                         % theorem / lemma / proof environments
\usepackage{algorithmic}                   % pseudocode algorithms
\usepackage{graphicx}                      % figures
\usepackage{textcomp}                      % special characters
\usepackage{xcolor}                        % figure colouring
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}          % hyperlinks (optional)

\def\BibTeX{{\rm B\kern-.05em{\sc i\kern-.025em b}\kern-.08em
    T\kern-.1667em\lower.7ex\hbox{E}\kern-.125emX}}

\begin{document}

\title{The Title of Your Paper}

\author{
\IEEEauthorblockN{First Author}
\IEEEauthorblockA{\textit{Department of Computer Science} \\
\textit{University of Somewhere} \\
City, Country \\
first.author@example.com}
\and
\IEEEauthorblockN{Second Author}
\IEEEauthorblockA{\textit{School of Engineering} \\
\textit{University of Somewhere} \\
City, Country \\
second.author@example.com}
}

\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
One paragraph of roughly 150--250 words. State the problem, the approach you
took, and the main result or contribution. Avoid equations and citations in
the abstract.
\end{abstract}

\begin{IEEEkeywords}
machine learning, research intelligence, similarity detection
\end{IEEEkeywords}

\section{Introduction}
Your introduction here. ...

\subsection{Motivation}
Your motivation subsection here. ...

\subsection{Contribution}
Your contribution statements here. ...

\section{Related Work}
...

\section{Methodology}
...

\section{Evaluation}
...

\section{Conclusion}
...

% ---- Bibliography ----
\bibliographystyle{IEEEtran}
\bibliography{references}

\end{document}
